fields.label: Kind
fields.description: Automatic: the machine works and the operator is free. Manual: an operator works

fields.label: While Machine Runs
fields.description: Manual work done while the machine runs (internal). Leave off when the machine waits for it (external), such as loading a stopped machine

fields.label: Seconds
fields.description: Standard time for one occurrence, before allowance

fields.label: Per
fields.description: Cycle: every cycle (or every N cycles). Batch: once per order, such as setup or first-article inspection

fields.label: Every N Cycles
fields.description: 1 for every cycle; 10 for a gauge check every tenth cycle
